title: 狗
prompt: The video shows a realistic front-facing autonomous driving scene on a broad urban intersection with marked lanes and roadside buildings in daylight. The ego vehicle is stopped or creeping very slowly. Exactly one medium-sized dog is already clearly visible close ahead at the beginning and walks diagonally from the right toward the left across the near foreground, moving slightly closer while remaining safely ahead. The animal remains fully visible in the front view throughout the clip, with a recognizable natural body, steady body size, grounded feet, and continuous motion. It stays separate from the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic. The other camera views show their corresponding road surroundings; the same animal appears in another view only if it enters that camera's field of view. The dog has short tan and gray-brown fur, a pale underside, a pale muzzle, and upright ears.
reference_origin: existing training reference pool; not a heldout identity benchmark
projection_scope: direct reference injection is region-gated; cross-view propagation is not strictly forbidden
web_encoding: H264 Main level4.1, CRF24, original resolution/frame count/PTS; source kept locally
quality_status: unfiltered stage observation; appearance and control quality not accepted
